CustomField.description: Written by: the commit step. Read by: everything that asks who a claim is about. THE CLAIM KEYS THE PARTICIPANT, ruled 5 August. Participant is ours and source-agnostic; the native ECI participant record is one input to it, never the identity. AAO_Subject_Contact__c stays for the rows written before this ruling and for the resolved Contact where one exists, but it is no longer the key: a person with no Contact was previously unclaimable, and Jefferson Vargas on the 17 June fixture is the specimen.
CustomField.label: Participant
